svg.title: F1 — Launch, browse, switch and return
svg.desc: Flow diagram: startup does not autoplay. Explicit resume plays Orchard. Browsing and favoriting Rivers leave Orchard playing. Cross-book activation checkpoints Orchard; unavailable audio offers download, never seeks the wrong book.
svg.text: F1 CONTINUE → BROWSE → EXPLICIT SWITCH
Action labels below are design intent, not a finalized key map.
F1.1 Launch / restore cached view
Restore selection and last-listened identity.
Stopped: NEVER autoplay. Offline browsing works.
F1.2 Explicitly play / resume Orchard
Load local audio at checkpoint with saved speed.
Miniplayer shows Orchard's loaded session.
F1.3 Highlight Rivers; optionally favorite
Details and chapters follow highlighted Rivers.
Orchard keeps playing or stays paused.
Favorite targets Rivers; no provider request.
F1.4 Activate a chapter in Rivers
Label as Switch to Rivers at chapter 02.
Confirmation policy remains open for review.
F1.4a Local audio unavailable
Offer download; do not claim a seek occurred.
Current Orchard audio remains unchanged.
F1.5 Commit explicit playback switch
Checkpoint Orchard; load Rivers at chosen chapter.
Player now labels Rivers. No smart-rewind seek.
F1.6 Return to Orchard explicitly
Select Orchard; Play resumes its checkpoint.
Merely revisiting it never switches audio.
Invariant checks for every transition
Highlighted book may differ from current audio.
Background refresh cannot steal focus or selection.
Space always addresses current loaded audio.
Editors own their input, including Space.
Failure / cancellation
Do not promise transactional playback rollback.
Keep prior checkpoint; show truthful load failure.
Cancel before switching leaves current audio alone.
Related journeys: J01, J02, J07, J08, J13, J17
Detailed dialogs, errors and minimum size
are follow-up frames, not approved by this flow.
